mechanism: Lock one adult portrait, background, lens distance and light so that performance changes remain directly comparable. Begin from a controlled emotional baseline, accumulate at least three small facial or breathing indicators without resetting them, resolve once into a single maximum expression, then use one brief self-protective concealment gesture. Reveal the face again and end with visible physiological or behavioral residue rather than restored neutrality. The reusable mechanism is calibrated baseline, cumulative restraint, single peak, protective concealment and residual recovery—not the source woman, face, earrings, grey garment, field background, tear pattern, exact expression, camera, timing, creator identity or unsupported model mapping.

invariants.rule: Lock one adult portrait, background, lens distance and light for the complete performance.
invariants.purpose: Makes microchanges comparable against a stable baseline.
invariants.ablation_failure: Camera or lighting changes can impersonate emotional progression.

invariants.rule: Accumulate at least three readable tension indicators without resetting earlier evidence.
invariants.purpose: Builds a continuous pressure curve rather than disconnected expressions.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent face poses become an expression test.

invariants.rule: Use exactly one maximum expression after the restrained build.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated peaks flatten the arc into cycling.

invariants.rule: Place one brief self-protective concealment gesture after the peak and then reveal the face again.
invariants.purpose: Adds behavioral consequence while preserving proof of recovery.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending fully hidden removes the final performance evidence.

invariants.rule: Hold visible emotional residue such as wet eyes, altered breath or gaze in the terminal state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Instant neutrality erases the cost of the peak.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's facial identity, hair, hoop earrings, grey garment and exact tear pattern
the source open field background, overcast light, wind behavior, lens and crop
the source lip, eye, cheek, crying, garment-cover and gaze sequence or exact timing
the source beauty rendering, skin texture, framing, performance identity and character likeness
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
